label: Executable machine-learning implementation
definition: An executable implementation of an algorithm or workflow in the ML-Schema setting, with its own software version.

label: Machine-learning evaluation specification
definition: A plan specifying which measures and assessment procedures evaluate a learning task.

label: Machine-learning evaluation procedure
definition: A statistical assessment procedure for measuring the behavior of a trained model, such as a resampling-based procedure.

label: Machine-learning evaluation measure
definition: A rule or metric used to quantify the performance of a learned model, such as predictive accuracy or an F-measure.

label: Machine-learning model evaluation result
definition: A reported value of a specified performance measure for a model evaluation, with the definition of that measure kept separate.

label: Machine-learning implementation run
definition: An execution of a versioned implementation in the ML-Schema model, with recorded inputs or outputs when available.
